comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Online and nursing-focused degree provider on Title IV; closest to GCE's end markets, though it operates schools rather than outsourcing services.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Online postsecondary degree operator with Title IV tuition economics and health sciences programs; similar end market, but it runs its own universities.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Online adult higher-education operator with Title IV exposure and similar enrollment economics; it owns universities rather than serving them as a contractor.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: K-12 virtual school operator and curriculum provider serving public schools; different students, funding and regulators than university outsourcing.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Campus-based vocational trade school with hands-on technician training; different programs and student base, and it is not an online or outsourced provider.
